verdict.rationale: Nitrokey's own materials say the Nitrokey 3 supports FIDO2 and can be used for passwordless login to Microsoft services and Nextcloud, which points toward resident-key support. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly mentions discoverable or resident credentials, passkeys, or username-less sign-in. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of discoverable/resident credential storage, username-less WebAuthn sign-in flow, credential capacity/management details, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the key stores discoverable FIDO2 credentials (resident keys / device-bound passkeys) so users can sign in to WebAuthn services without typing a username

citations.quote: use Nitrokey for passwordless login instead
